a.lede: A critical vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell in OpenJDK, the open-source implementation of Java, can allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on popular enterprise applications, including Jenkins, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and Keycloak. [...]
a.title: Critical Java4Shell flaw allows RCE attacks on major Java applications
